behavior.arguments: rdi = out pointer (three qwords written); rsi = record pointer: [rsi] = first node, [rsi+8] = index, [rsi+0x10] = key. No other argument is read.

edges.exhausted: chain ends (next node is 0): store (0, last node, last index); the input key is not stored on this path.
edges.multi_step: each passing gate advances one node and increments the index; the gate word compared is always the pre-advance node's +0xe4 word.
edges.path1: key < word[first node + 0xe6]: store (first node, index, key) and return; the key survives only on this path.
edges.path2_correction: walk stops when word[stopping node + 0xe6] > word[previous node + 0xe4]: store (stopping node, steps, previous node's +0xe4 word zero-extended) — NOT the input key, which the loop's movzwl into esi clobbered. A scout note describing all three paths as storing (node, steps, key) is wrong for paths 2 and 3.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with mov %rdi,%rax (NOT endbr64); conditional early exits only (jae/je), zero calls; three rets, one per path.
behavior.return_rule: If key < word[first+0xe6]: store (first, index, key). Else walk: while next != 0, steps += 1, gate = word[cur+0xe4], cur = next; if word[cur+0xe6] <= gate, continue; else store (cur, steps, gate). If next == 0: store (0, last node, last index). All comparisons unsigned; gate words zero-extended from 16-bit loads.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; exactly one site found, inside the retained caller FDE. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: Zero R_X86_64_RELATIVE records in any .rela.* section name this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
